title: Gang Cut 10H2
heading: The Bank Robbery MV, cut 10H2: Her in the gang, round 2
intro: Round 2 of the cut with the gang's new leader. The signed-off cut (10B5) with her in 27 shots: the 19 from round 1 plus the 8 you approved on the shots page (the Tommy-gun walk, the bank doors, the cellar, looking down into the lens, the balloon field, dancing in the street, walking out of the exploding bank, the girder). Every cut, in-point and length is exactly as before. The devil's radio station and the pool table are the originals, as you chose. Note any shot where she doesn't land, the motion feels off, or a beat no longer hits; when it's right, it goes into Premiere as Balaclava Gang 11.
